Wyrix News is a news discovery app. It shows headlines, short descriptions, source names and links. Full articles always open on the publisher's own website.

Providers
• FreeNewsAPI.ai - a free, keyless news search API. Every article links back to its original publisher. The service is provided as-is with no uptime guarantee, and country and language tags are inferred.
• Publisher RSS feeds - only if configured when the app was built.

Limits
Coverage differs by region and language. Some states, union territories and countries may show little or no recent news. Wyrix News never writes or edits news; when nothing is available it says so.

Wyrix News has no accounts and does not ask for your name, e-mail address, contacts, location, camera or microphone.

Stored on your device only
• Saved articles (title, link, source, short excerpt)
• Recently loaded headlines (cache)
• Preferences: theme, favorites, recent searches
Clear the app's storage or uninstall to delete them.

Network
To load news, the app sends your search words or the selected region and category, plus your IP address, to FreeNewsAPI.ai and, if configured, to publisher RSS servers. To show thumbnails, the app downloads the beginning of each article's web page from its publisher and reads its preview image. Reading an article inside the app loads the publisher's website in an in-app browser, which has its own privacy policy.

Wyrix News shows ads from Google AdMob, which may collect your device's advertising ID and approximate location. It uses no other analytics and sends no notifications.

Wyrix News is built with open-source software:

• AndroidX, Jetpack Compose, Room, DataStore, Navigation (Apache License 2.0)
• Kotlin, kotlinx.coroutines, kotlinx.serialization (Apache License 2.0)
• OkHttp (Apache License 2.0)
• Coil (Apache License 2.0)
• Google Mobile Ads SDK (Google's terms)
